alias_policy.ac_plug: Plug contacts A/B are arbitrary source aliases; no hot/neutral polarization is assigned.
alias_policy.switch: #16 switch_a and switch_b are the electrical ends of a single contact pair, not numbered physical lugs.
alias_policy.heater: V5:1 and V3:8 are the free heater ends under the already reviewed series order and manufacturer pin roles. Pin 1/8 within a heater has no externally defined polarity in the published schematic; physical lead-to-socket orientation is retained as a crosswalk limit.
alias_policy.rectifier: RCA 35Z3 pin review maps the 35Z3 plate to V5:2; Philco p.38 independently traces the plate glyph from the #30 tap.

verified_endpoints.joined_factory_member: end of heater chain at switched B−

open_items: The source does not number #16 physical switch lugs or polarize the plug; logical switch contacts are recorded as aliases.

The original wiring at the 35Z3/7C6 free heater ends is identified by functional pin roles; the schematic does not print socket contact numbers. Physical orientation and unreviewed intermediate heater assignment remain open.
The source does not establish a chassis-to-B− bond or an isolation transformer.
Receiver behavior and full engineering-complete gate remain open.
